conversation.welcome: Hi. This is a space to talk about something important, something everyday, or something completely small. I'll help you go through the topic step by step, understand each other better and find agreement more easily. Start separately or together.

advisorStatus.calming: The advisor is easing the tension…
advisorStatus.presenceWaitFor: is waiting for a reply from
advisorStatus.presenceWaitBoth: is waiting for your joint reply

placeholders.DEEPEN: Go ahead, say more — what do you feel most strongly?
placeholders.CLARIFY: Be specific — one example instead of a judgment…
placeholders.NARROW: One concrete example from the past week…
placeholders.REFRAME: Say directly what matters most to you…
placeholders.CHOOSE: Which topic matters most to you both right now?
placeholders.PROPOSE: Suggest a small step to try out…
placeholders.INTERVENE: Try starting with "I feel…" instead of a judgment…
placeholders.askOther: Your turn, {{name}} — how do you see it?
placeholders.paused: Write to each other — the advisor is just listening…
placeholders.idle: Come back when you're ready — write together how it went…

safety.short: Relvia is an AI advisor, not a therapist
safety.full: Relvia is an AI advisor, not a therapist or an emergency service. If you need urgent help, call 112. Emotional support in Poland: the 24/7 helpline 116 123; in cases of violence — the "Blue Line" 800 120 002.
safety.help: If you need urgent help, call 112. Emotional support in Poland: the 24/7 helpline 116 123; in cases of violence — the "Blue Line" 800 120 002.
safety.acceptFull: By using Relvia, you accept the <terms>Terms of Use</terms> and the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

legal.testBannerBody: Relvia is available to invited testers only and is not a public service yet. Thank you for being with us at this stage.

errors.RATE_LIMIT: Too fast — give it a moment and try again.
errors.MESSAGE_TOO_LONG: The message is too long — shorten it and try again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You don't have access to this conversation.
errors.ADVISOR_ERROR: The advisor couldn't respond right now. Please try again.
errors.NOT_CONFIRMED: The server didn't confirm the message was sent.
errors.MODE_FAILED: Could not change the advisor mode.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
